description.vi: Embe Chanh từ lúc mới về JennyMiaw tai đã bị lẹm mất một góc, gầy hom hem, hô hấp hắt xì ra máo. Sau bao nhiu ngày chăm nom thuốc thang, nâng như nâng trứng, thì Chanh đã khỏi rùi (trộm vía). Chanh mềm mại, ngọt ngào, quấn người, tình cảm. Hãy chơi với Chanh nhẹ nhàng nhé 🫶🏻
description.en:
When little Chanh first arrived at JennyMiaw, one of her ears was already missing a little piece. She was painfully skinny and frail, and had respiratory problems so bad that she would sneeze blood. 🥺

After many days of care, medication, and being treated like the most precious little egg, Chanh has finally recovered (knock on wood)! 🥹🫶🏻

Now she’s soft, sweet, affectionate, and absolutely loves being around people. Please be gentle when playing with Chanh. 🫶🏻💕
